AKISISTER-DRAIN_POWER.description:
Creatures afflicted with [gold]Decay[/gold] deal [blue]15%[/blue] less attack damage.
At the start of their turn, they lose HP.
[gold]Decay[/gold] decreases by [blue]1/5[/blue] each turn.

AKISISTER-WITHER_POWER.description:

AKISISTER-AUTUMN_AURA_POWER.description:
When you would lose HP from blockable damage, if you have enough [gold]Autumn Essence[/gold], prevent that HP loss and lose that much [gold]Autumn Essence[/gold] instead.
At the start of each turn, convert [blue]1/3[/blue] of your [gold]Autumn Essence[/gold] into [gold]Temporary Autumn Essence[/gold].
Whenever [gold]Autumn Essence[/gold] is reduced, apply [gold]Wither[/gold] equal to half the amount reduced to a random enemy.
